fusions.name: Springboard
fusions.desc: Kicks off a target for 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Lookout's Bark
fusions.desc: A warning bark that deals 26 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone at the Snap
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Pricked Ears
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 6% more dodge chance.
